records.relationship: shared inline keyline for Header, Content and Footer

disposition.reason: The shared alias supplies panel-section content breathing; Footer implements the same keyline as margin so its divider stays inset.

records.relationship: block insets on Header, Content and Footer sections

disposition.reason: Each child section owns its block-edge breathing; arbitrary Content children do not imply an internal stack gap.

records.relationship: inline gap between the panel title and close action

disposition.reason: The title and close action are peers; this is not marker-to-copy separation.

records.relationship: inline gap between peer panel footer actions

disposition.reason: The footer repeats the Modal/Card peer-item relationship and strengthens the role's recurrence.

records.relationship: host-authored symmetric compact inset for an icon-only close Button

disposition.reason: SidePanel and Modal repeat the same host override; CP1 must raise a Button variant/role candidate or justify one bounded host exception under FR-047a.

records.relationship: Header-to-Content and Content-to-Footer block separation

disposition.reason: CP1 must decide whether SidePanel, Modal and Card deliberately compose adjacent surface insets or should move separation to a container-owned group gap.

records.relationship: negative cancellation of Button's internal gap for the zero-width baseline shim

disposition.reason: This compensates an icon-only baseline workaround; it is not peer separation and must disappear with or remain owned by that workaround.

records.relationship: heading-sized title inside a baseline-aligned flex header

disposition.reason: The accepted closure model is independent of --space-after; current-main SidePanel was not in T004 evidence and can gain a full body-line closure unless T008/CP1 resolves component text closure.

records.relationship: inline gap between peer footer items

disposition.reason: Peer items are adjacent elements in one footer unit; they are not a marker-and-copy pair.

records.relationship: inline gap between peer footer actions

disposition.reason: Peer actions require an inline element role; using element.block would violate the axis contract.

records.relationship: inline gap between the slider and number control

disposition.reason: The slider and number field are peer controls, not a mark and its label.

records.relationship: block gap between adjacent choices in one field

disposition.reason: Adjacent choices belong to one field unit; the prior group assignment overstated the hierarchy.

records.relationship: inline gap between adjacent choice columns

disposition.reason: The two-value gap shorthand needs an axis-correct inline peer relationship.

records.relationship: inline gap between a checkbox/radio mark and its label

disposition.reason: This is the defining marker-to-copy relationship and must not merge with peer separation.

records.relationship: inline gap between header artwork and copy

disposition.reason: Artwork-to-copy separation is the mark role, not a generic peer gap.

records.relationship: inline gap between the optional icon and tooltip copy

disposition.reason: The optional icon is a leading mark; the tooltip panel inset remains independent.

records.relationship: distance between trigger and positioned tooltip

disposition.reason: Placement can be top, bottom, left or right, so a block-only gap role is false; retain a reviewed positioning magnitude.

records.relationship: inline separation inside the token swatch composite

disposition.reason: The frozen row is a legacy-magnitude boundary; CP1 must prove recurrence before promoting this component-specific composite spacing.

records.relationship: block separation between Card header and content sections

disposition.reason: CP1 must choose whether the seam intentionally composes two surface insets or is one group gap; value coincidence cannot decide it.

records.relationship: variant-scoped Section block edges

disposition.reason: Shallow/framed uses the component surface inset; default, deep and hero use the external strip/page-section inset under FR-053a.

records.relationship: Svelte Section variant block insets remain on primitive aliases

disposition.reason: FR-036 keeps this fork out of the React spike; its surface/strip variant split must be migrated by its own owner.

records.relationship: App element/group/pattern ordering and removal of the legacy section alias

disposition.reason: The proposed 4/16/32 App sequence resolves the live 8/8/32/16 contradiction; provider implementation remains post-CP2 migration debt.

records.relationship: application-shell padding

disposition.reason: Application-shell padding is outside the component taxonomy and must not widen the migrated package set.

records.relationship: application-scaffold shell padding

disposition.reason: Application scaffold geometry is not a design-system component role.

records.relationship: Storybook spacing-contract fixture literals

disposition.reason: The fixture is evidence chrome and changes only when comparison evidence requires it.

records.relationship: Svelte Cards row/column gap

disposition.reason: FR-036 and FR-040 keep this non-React grid consumer explicit; do not soften it in the component taxonomy.

records.relationship: popover separator row with only a block-start border

disposition.reason: Re-cut through actual per-edge borders; symmetric nominal-border subtraction leaves the borderless end edge one pixel short.

records.relationship: fractional phase padding plus closure margin rounds down separately

disposition.reason: Chromium loses 1/64px per closed text element; CP1 must choose a metric bound and whether authority sits at CP1 or CP2.
